source.text: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥דשָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: The song of the ascents, of David. I rejoiced in [those who] said to me, [The] house of YHWH let us go.

en.L: A song of ascents. Of David. I rejoiced when they said to me, "[To the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} let us go."
en.B: A song of ascents. Of David. I was full of joy when they said to me, "Come, let us set out for the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!"
en.R: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem. By David. I was so happy when people said to me, "Come on, we are going to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!"

fr.L: Cantique des montées. De David. Je me suis réjoui quand on m’a dit : « [À la] maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, allons ! »
fr.B: Cantique des montées. De David. J’ai été rempli de joie quand on m’a dit : « Venez, mettons-nous en route vers la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! »
fr.R: Chant pour la montée vers Jérusalem. De David. J’ai été si heureux quand des gens m’ont dit : « Venez, nous allons à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! »

sw.L: Wimbo wa kupanda. Wa Daudi. Nilifurahi waliponiambia, "[Kwenye] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} twende."
sw.B: Wimbo wa kupanda. Wa Daudi. Nilijawa na furaha waliponiambia, "Haya, tuanze safari kwenda nyumbani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!"
sw.R: Wimbo wa safari ya kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu. Wa Daudi. Nilifurahi sana watu waliponiambia, "Haya, twende nyumbani kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!"

es.L: Cántico de las subidas. De David. Me alegré cuando me dijeron: «[A la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vayamos».
es.B: Cántico de las subidas. De David. Me llené de alegría cuando me dijeron: «¡Vamos, pongámonos en camino hacia la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}!».
es.R: Canto para el viaje de subida a Jerusalén. De David. Me puse muy feliz cuando me dijeron: «¡Vamos, nos vamos a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}!».

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: As in 120:1, the short title and the first line are counted together as verse 1, so the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a song of ascents: probably a pilgrim song
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one of the fifteen songs probably sung by pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: of David: linked with David
decisions.reason: Four of the Songs of Ascents (122, 124, 131, 133) add "of David", and one (127) "of Solomon". As elsewhere in the Psalms, "of" may mean the psalm is by him, belongs to a collection named for him, or is written for or about him. Some ancient copies of these titles lack the name.

decisions.choice: in those who said: when they said
decisions.reason: The preposition (be) with "those saying" can mean "when they said" or "(I rejoiced) with those who said". Either way the joy comes from the invitation to go to the LORD's house.

decisions.choice: the house of the LORD: the temple
decisions.reason: The house of the LORD is the temple in Jerusalem (verse 9), where the tribes went up for the festivals (verse 4).

decisions.choice: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in 120:1.

records.literal_gloss: Standing were our feet in your gates, Jerusalem.

en.L: Our feet were standing within your gates, Jerusalem.
en.B: Now here we are, standing inside your gates, Jerusalem!
en.R: Now we are here, Jerusalem! We are standing inside your city gates!

fr.L: Nos pieds se tenaient dans tes portes, Jérusalem.
fr.B: Nous voici, debout à l’intérieur de tes portes, Jérusalem !
fr.R: Nous sommes arrivés, Jérusalem ! Nous voici debout dans les portes de ta ville !

sw.L: Miguu yetu ilikuwa imesimama ndani ya malango yako, Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Sasa tuko hapa, tumesimama ndani ya malango yako, Ee Yerusalemu!
sw.R: Sasa tumefika, Yerusalemu! Tumesimama ndani ya malango ya mji wako!

es.L: Nuestros pies estaban plantados dentro de tus puertas, Jerusalén.
es.B: ¡Aquí estamos ya, de pie dentro de tus puertas, Jerusalén!
es.R: ¡Ya estamos aquí, Jerusalén! ¡Estamos de pie dentro de las puertas de tu ciudad!

decisions.choice: were standing: we have arrived and stand
alternatives: a memory: our feet once stood
decisions.reason: The verb "to be" with a participle describes a lasting state. In context the pilgrims have arrived and now stand inside the city; some read it as a memory of a past visit.

decisions.choice: we are standing
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "we" for "our feet"; Literal keeps the picture.

records.literal_gloss: Jerusalem, the built [one], like a city that is joined to itself together,

en.L: Jerusalem, the built [one], like a city that is joined to itself together,
en.B: Jerusalem, built as a city whose buildings are joined close together,
en.R: Jerusalem is a well-built city. Its walls and houses fit tightly together.

fr.L: Jérusalem, la bâtie, comme une ville qui est liée à elle-même ensemble,
fr.B: Jérusalem, bâtie comme une ville dont les maisons se serrent les unes contre les autres,
fr.R: Jérusalem est une ville bien construite. Ses murs et ses maisons sont bien serrés les uns contre les autres.

sw.L: Yerusalemu, uliojengwa, kama mji ulioungamanishwa wenyewe pamoja,
sw.B: Yerusalemu, uliojengwa kama mji ambao majengo yake yameshikamana pamoja,
sw.R: Yerusalemu ni mji uliojengwa vizuri. Kuta zake na nyumba zake zimeshikamana sana.

es.L: Jerusalén, la edificada, como una ciudad que está unida consigo misma,
es.B: Jerusalén, edificada como una ciudad cuyos edificios están bien unidos,
es.R: Jerusalén es una ciudad bien construida. Sus murallas y sus casas encajan bien unas con otras.

decisions.choice: joined together: compact and united
alternatives: a city that unites its people
rebuilt and joined to its old walls
decisions.reason: The verb (chubbar) means joined or bound together. It pictures a solid, compact city with no gaps in its walls, and perhaps also a city that draws the tribes together into one people (verse 4).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 4 continues with "where", so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: Its walls and houses fit tightly together
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the plainest sense of the picture (m1).

source.text: שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי־יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: where there went up tribes, [the] tribes of Yah, a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to [the] name of YHWH.

en.L: where the tribes went up, the tribes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, [as] a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: where the tribes make their way up, the tribes that belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, as was decreed for Israel, to give thanks to the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: That is where the tribes of Israel go up. They are the tribes that belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}. They go there to give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as Israel was commanded to do.

fr.L: où sont montées les tribus, les tribus {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yah}}, [selon] le témoignage pour Israël, pour rendre grâce au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: où montent les tribus, les tribus qui appartiennent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yah}}, comme il a été prescrit à Israël, pour rendre grâce au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: C’est là que montent les tribus d’Israël. Ce sont les tribus qui appartiennent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yah}}. Elles y vont pour remercier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme Israël en a reçu l’ordre.

sw.L: ambako makabila yalipanda, makabila ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, [kama] ushuhuda kwa Israeli, kulishukuru jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: ambako makabila hupanda, makabila ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, kama ilivyoamriwa kwa Israeli, kulishukuru jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Huko ndiko makabila ya Israeli yanakopanda. Hayo ni makabila ambayo ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}. Yanakwenda huko kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama Israeli walivyoamriwa kufanya.

es.L: adonde subieron las tribus, las tribus {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yah}}, [como] testimonio para Israel, para dar gracias al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: adonde suben las tribus, las tribus que pertenecen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}, según lo mandado a Israel, para dar gracias al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Allí suben las tribus de Israel. Son las tribus que pertenecen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}. Van allí a dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como se le mandó a Israel.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2 and in "Hallelu-yah"). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: went up: the custom of the tribes
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form usually used for past events, here describing what the tribes did again and again; so Balanced and Readable say "go up".

decisions.choice: testimony: a decree
decisions.reason: The word ('edut) is used of God's law as a solemn charge. Israel was commanded to go up to the place God chose three times a year (Exodus 23:17; Deuteronomy 16:16).

decisions.choice: the name of the LORD: the LORD himself
decisions.reason: The name stands for the LORD as he has made himself known. Thanking his name is thanking him.

decisions.choice: give thanks to the LORD
alternatives: to the name of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the idiom (m4).

decisions.choice: the short name Yah under the divine-name setting, with "le SEIGNEUR" as the default
decisions.reason: Yah is the short form of the divine name. As the terms note sets, French gives it the default "le SEIGNEUR" and shows "Yah" to readers who choose the name.

decisions.choice: The short name Yah as "BWANA", with "Yah" as the alternative
alternatives: "Yahwe" as the alternative, as for the full name
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here uses Yah, the short form of the divine name (see the meaning decision). Swahili shows it like the full name, BWANA, and the setting that shows the name gives the short form "Yah", as the English does.

source.text: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה׀יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: For there sat thrones for judgment, thrones of [the] house of David.

en.L: For there sit thrones for judgment, thrones of the house of David.
en.B: For there the seats of justice are placed, the royal thrones of David's family.
en.R: That is where kings from David's family sit on their thrones to judge the people.

fr.L: Car là siègent des trônes pour le jugement, des trônes de la maison de David.
fr.B: Car là sont dressés les sièges de la justice, les trônes royaux de la famille de David.
fr.R: C’est là que les rois de la famille de David sont assis sur leur trône pour juger le peuple.

sw.L: Kwa maana huko vinakaa viti vya enzi kwa ajili ya hukumu, viti vya enzi vya nyumba ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa maana huko viti vya haki vimewekwa, viti vya kifalme vya ukoo wa Daudi.
sw.R: Huko ndiko wafalme wa ukoo wa Daudi wanakoketi katika viti vyao vya enzi ili kuwahukumu watu.

es.L: Porque allí están los tronos para el juicio, los tronos de la casa de David.
es.B: Porque allí están puestos los asientos de la justicia, los tronos reales de la familia de David.
es.R: Allí es donde los reyes de la familia de David se sientan en sus tronos para juzgar al pueblo.

decisions.choice: thrones for judgment: the king as judge
decisions.reason: The king was the highest judge of the land, and people came to Jerusalem to have their cases decided (2 Samuel 15:2-4; 1 Kings 3:16-28; 7:7).

decisions.choice: thrones sat: thrones were set up
decisions.reason: The verb (yashav) usually means "sit" or "stay"; with thrones as subject it means they are set in place.

decisions.choice: the house of David: David's royal family
decisions.reason: "House" here means a family line, the kings descended from David (2 Samuel 7:11-16).

decisions.choice: kings ... sit ... to judge the people
decisions.reason: Readable names the kings that the thrones stand for (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Ask [for the] peace of Jerusalem: May they be at ease, [those who] love you.

en.L: Ask [for] the peace of Jerusalem: "May those who love you be at ease.
en.B: Pray that Jerusalem will have peace: "May all who love you live at ease.
en.R: Pray for peace in Jerusalem. Say, "May everyone who loves you be safe.

fr.L: Demandez la paix de Jérusalem : « Qu’ils soient tranquilles, ceux qui t’aiment !
fr.B: Priez pour que Jérusalem ait la paix : « Que tous ceux qui t’aiment vivent tranquilles !
fr.R: Priez pour la paix de Jérusalem. Dites : « Que tous ceux qui t’aiment soient en sécurité !

sw.L: Ombeni [kwa ajili ya] amani ya Yerusalemu: "Wakae kwa utulivu wale wanaokupenda.
sw.B: Ombeni Yerusalemu upate amani: "Wote wanaokupenda waishi kwa utulivu.
sw.R: Ombeni amani kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu. Semeni, "Kila mtu anayekupenda awe salama.

es.L: {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} la paz de Jerusalén: «Que estén tranquilos los que te aman.
es.B: {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} para que Jerusalén tenga paz: «Que vivan tranquilos todos los que te aman.
es.R: {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} por la paz de Jerusalén. {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}}: «Que todos los que te aman estén a salvo.

decisions.choice: a play on sounds: peace
decisions.reason: The verse repeats the sounds of "peace" (shalom): sha'alu shelom yerushalayim yishlayu, "ask peace for Jerusalem, may they be at peace". The name of the city itself echoes the same sounds.

decisions.choice: the words of the prayer
alternatives: a separate promise: those who love you will prosper
decisions.reason: After "ask for the peace of Jerusalem" comes what to pray, spoken to the city: the wish runs on through verse 7. It can also be read as a promise to those who pray ("they will prosper").

decisions.choice: be at ease: live in security and quiet
decisions.reason: The verb (shalah) means to be quiet, secure and untroubled (Job 3:26; 12:6); prosperity may be included.

decisions.choice: Say
decisions.reason: Readable shows that the words that follow are the prayer (m2).

decisions.choice: plural_you on "Pidan" (L), "Oren" (B, R) and "Digan" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew command "ask" is plural, spoken to the pilgrims; Spanish marks it with the plural_you setting (Pidan / Pedid, Oren / Orad, Digan / Decid).

records.literal_gloss: May there be peace in your rampart, security in your fortresses.

en.L: May there be peace within your rampart, security within your fortresses."
en.B: Let your walls be at peace and your strongholds be secure."
en.R: May there be peace along your walls. May your strong towers be safe."

fr.L: Que la paix soit dans ton rempart, la tranquillité dans tes forteresses ! »
fr.B: Que la paix règne dans tes murs, et la sécurité dans tes forteresses ! »
fr.R: Que la paix règne le long de tes murs ! Que tes tours solides soient en sécurité ! »

sw.L: Amani iwe ndani ya boma lako, utulivu ndani ya ngome zako."
sw.B: Kuta zako ziwe na amani, na ngome zako ziwe salama."
sw.R: Amani iwe katika kuta zako zote. Minara yako imara iwe salama."

es.L: Haya paz dentro de tu muralla, seguridad dentro de tus fortalezas».
es.B: Que haya paz en tus murallas y seguridad en tus fortalezas».
es.R: Que haya paz a lo largo de tus murallas. Que tus torres fuertes estén seguras».

decisions.choice: rampart: the outer wall
decisions.reason: The word (chel) is the outer defenses of a city: the wall and the ground before it.

decisions.choice: fortresses: the strong buildings of the city
decisions.reason: The word ('armon) is a large fortified building, such as a palace or tower within the city.

decisions.choice: security: quiet ease
decisions.reason: The word (shalvah) comes from the same root as "be at ease" in verse 6.

source.text: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For the sake of my brothers and my friends I will speak, please, Peace [be] in you.

en.L: For the sake of my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} and my friends I will say now, "Peace [be] within you."
en.B: For the sake of my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} and my friends I will say, "May peace be inside you!"
en.R: Because I care about my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} and my friends, I will say, "Jerusalem, may you have peace!"

fr.L: À cause de mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} et de mes amis, je dirai donc : « La paix [soit] en toi ! »
fr.B: À cause de mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} et de mes amis, je dirai : « Que la paix soit en toi ! »
fr.R: Parce que j’aime mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} et mes amis, je dirai : « Jérusalem, que la paix soit avec toi ! »

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya ndugu zangu na rafiki zangu nitasema sasa, "Amani [iwe] ndani yako."
sw.B: Kwa ajili ya ndugu zangu na rafiki zangu nitasema, "Amani iwe ndani yako!"
sw.R: Kwa sababu ninawajali ndugu zangu na rafiki zangu, nitasema, "Yerusalemu, uwe na amani!"

es.L: Por amor de mis hermanos y de mis amigos diré ahora: «La paz [sea] dentro de ti».
es.B: Por amor de mis hermanos y de mis amigos diré: «¡Que haya paz dentro de ti!».
es.R: Porque quiero a mis hermanos y a mis amigos, diré: «¡Jerusalén, que tengas paz!».

decisions.choice: brothers: fellow members of the people
decisions.reason: The word ('ach) is used of relatives and of fellow Israelites, men and women alike. With "friends" it means the people the psalmist belongs to.

decisions.choice: you: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: "You" is feminine singular, spoken to the city, as in verses 2, 6 and 7.

decisions.choice: brothers and sisters
decisions.reason: The word includes the whole people (m1); the gender setting gives the traditional "brothers".

decisions.choice: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable names the city spoken to (m2).

decisions.choice: "ndugu zangu" with no gender setting
alternatives: "ndugu zangu wa kiume" as a traditional alternative
decisions.reason: Swahili "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters alike, so the inclusive sense of the English setting is in the word itself and there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: hermanos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a setting for "brothers and sisters". Spanish "hermanos" already includes women as well as men, so it stays plain at every level.

source.text: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For the sake of [the] house of YHWH our God I will seek good for you.

en.L: For the sake of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God I will seek good for you.
en.B: Because the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is here, I will work for what is good for you.
en.R: The house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is in you, Jerusalem. So I will do all I can to bring you good things.

fr.L: À cause de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, je chercherai du bien pour toi.
fr.B: Parce que la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu est ici, je travaillerai à ton bien.
fr.R: La maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu est chez toi, Jérusalem. Alors je ferai tout ce que je peux pour ton bonheur.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu nitakutafutia mema.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu iko hapa, nitajitahidi kwa ajili ya mema yako.
sw.R: Nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu iko ndani yako, Yerusalemu. Kwa hiyo nitafanya yote ninayoweza kukuletea mambo mema.

es.L: Por amor de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios buscaré tu bien.
es.B: Porque la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios está aquí, trabajaré por lo que es bueno para ti.
es.R: La casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios está en ti, Jerusalén. Por eso haré todo lo que pueda para traerte cosas buenas.

decisions.choice: for the sake of the house: because the temple is there
decisions.reason: The psalmist seeks the city's good because the LORD's house stands in it. The verse closes the psalm as it began, with the house of the LORD (verse 1).

decisions.choice: seek good: work and pray for the city's good
decisions.reason: To seek someone's good is to want it and to work for it (Esther 10:3; Jeremiah 29:7).

decisions.choice: is here (B); is in you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the reason implied by "for the sake of" (m1).
